content.text: Digital creators often face barriers with conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-working-today|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal, which can be inaccessible in regions like Africa and South America. COREMERCH provides a robust solution with a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to deploy a fully functional digital store without relying on these platforms. This guide will walk you through deploying your digital store on Cloudflare Pages using Stack 02, enabling seamless crypto payments and [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-5|GitHub Pages]].io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-2|complete]] ownership of your data.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in regions with high financial restrictions. By leveraging infrastructure like Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you build a resilient system that doesn't depend on third-party services. Your digital store's architecture ensures that you own your data and have complete control over transactions. This independence allows you to operate without the limitations of conventional financial services, opening up access to global markets and enabling creators to thrive.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting the deployment process, make sure you have a GitHub account for version control and a Cloudflare account to manage your domain and hosting. You'll also need your products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, courses, or digital assets. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Documenting your deployment plan helps streamline the process, ensuring that all components integrate smoothly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring Cloudflare Pages to host your storefront, ensuring you optimize the performance settings for faster load times. Next, implement Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic, such as processing orders and managing customer interactions. Integrate Supabase for order storage, allowing you to track purchases efficiently. Once your backend is functional, set up NOWPayments to handle payments. This configuration enables you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring that your customers can transact easily and securely.
Complete ownership of your data means no dependency on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your digital store set up and tested, it's time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site and ensure that all links and payment gateways function correctly. Conduct a test transaction to confirm that payments are processed seamlessly through NOWPayments. This step is crucial; verify that the webhook fires correctly when a payment is confirmed. Once you confirm that everything is operating smoothly, promote your store through social media and other channels to attract your target audience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is active, focus on gathering user feedback to identify areas for improvement. Explore adding more products or features based on customer demand. Consider utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for enhanced capabilities, including advanced analytics and user management. Regularly update your offerings and optimize your SEO strategy to increase visibility. Scale your operations by connecting with your audience through email marketing and social media to drive traffic and sales.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account for hosting your digital store. Set up a GitHub account for version control and product management. Prepare your digital products for upload. Configure Cloudflare Pages to host your storefront. Implement Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Integrate Supabase for order tracking. Set up NOWPayments for crypto payments. Publish your site and conduct test transactions. Promote your store through various channels.

What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. In contrast, Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more robust infrastructure deployed by COREMERCH in just 48 hours, ensuring end-to-end functionality.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each platform has its benefits; GitHub Pages is excellent for static sites, while Cloudflare Pages provides enhanced performance and features necessary for a dynamic digital storefront.
What payment methods can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, offering flexibility in payment options for your customers. This service ensures quick transaction processing with minimal fees, enhancing the purchasing experience.
How do I ensure my digital store is secure?

To secure your digital store, implement HTTPS through Cloudflare, utilize security features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email protection, and ensure that your payment processing is handled by reputable services like NOWPayments to minimize risks.
